Question ID: ANP_U01_L03_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.LAB.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Data, Models, Graphs, and Medical Evidence
Stimulus: Data/model/medical evidence stimulus

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, read the title and units before interpreting data. Then use the required stimulus (Data/model/medical evidence stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to medical models, graphs, tables, and evidence limits. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.LAB.02 and avoids the common mistake: treating any medical-looking image or graph as proof.
